items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: We had him playing with us, sir.

ctx.x: When we made that big show here in town there, you remember? Uh-huh. Boy, he had him a big bottle like that. Yeah. He said, man, he said, I want to get up there and blow something. They ain't playing nothing. Let me blow something.
Did you ever work with Al Morgan? You remember him? His bass player?
Albert Morgan? Uh-huh. Yes, sir. We had him playing with us, sir. You played with Rainey, too. Oh, yeah. He played a long time with Rainey.
